en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's go in the freezer
Let's have some tea
Let's try fasting
Oh? Like hide-and-seek?

You must feel pretty confident to challenge
me to hide-and-seek.
Cuz, cuz, cuz...nothing can escape Atua's sight.

Even if you hide in the center of the earth,
Atua will find you every time.
Just try and hide from me, Shuichi!
Nyahahaha! Fancy-schmancy, Shuichi!

I'm all for tea time, but whose blood are you
gonna use?
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>I'm *positive* I didn't hear that right.

Hm? But you can't hear Atua's voice if you're
hungry.

Do you want Atua to stop talking to me,
Shuichi?

No one can come between me and Atua.
Not even you.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Angie looks deep in thought...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Angie's inner thoughts...?
